questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \to 0} (\cos x)^{ \frac{1}{x}} = [\quad]
questions.analysis_html: \lim_{x \to 0} (\cos x)^{\frac{1}{x}} = \lim_{x \to 0} [1 + (\cos x - 1)]^{\frac{1}{\cos x - 1} \frac{\cos x - 1}{x}} = e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{\cos x - 1}{x}} = e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{-x^2}{2}} = e^0 = 1

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow e} \frac{ \ln x - 1 } { x - e } = [ \quad ]
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\lim_{x \rightarrow e} \frac{\ln x - 1}{x - e} &= \lim_{x \rightarrow e} \frac{\ln x - \ln e}{x - e} = \lim_{x \rightarrow e} \ln(\frac{x}{e})^{\frac{1}{x - e}} \\&= \lim_{x \rightarrow e} \ln(1 + \frac{x - e}{e})^{\frac{e}{x - e} \cdot \frac{1}{e}} = \frac{1}{e}\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} ( \frac {x - a } { x + a } ) ^ { x } = 9 , \text{则} a = [ \quad ] .

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} ( \frac {x-1} {x+1} ) ^ {x-4} = [\quad]

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \to 0} (1+2x)^{\frac{\sin x}{x}} = [\quad].

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{n \rightarrow \infty} n [ \ln ( n - 1 ) - \ln n ] = [ \quad ] .

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l}\lim\limits_{n \rightarrow \infty} n [ \ln (n-1) - \ln n ] = \lim\limits_{n \rightarrow \infty} \ln (\frac{n-1}{n})^{n} = \lim\limits_{n \rightarrow \infty} \ln (1 - \frac{1}{n})^{n} \\ \\ = \ln e^{-1} = -1 \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow \infty} ( \frac {x+2a}{x-a} ) ^{x} = 8 , \text{则} a = [ \quad ]
questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} 8 = \lim\limits_{x \rightarrow \infty} (\dfrac{x+2a}{x-a})^{x} = \lim\limits_{x \rightarrow \infty} \dfrac{(1+ \dfrac{2a}{x})^{x}}{(1- \dfrac{a}{x})^{x}} = e^{3a}, \text{则} \; e^{a} = 2, a = \ln 2 \end{array}

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \rightarrow 0} (1+3x)^{\frac{2}{\sin x}} = [\quad]
questions.analysis_html: \lim_{x \to 0} (1 + 3x)^{\frac{1}{3x} \frac{6x}{\sin x}} = e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{6x}{\sin x}} = e^{6}.

questions.prompt_html: \text{极限} \lim_{x \to 0} ( \frac{1 + \tan x }{1 + \sin x} ) ^ { \frac { 1 } { x ^ { 3 } } } = [ \quad ] .
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}(\frac{1+\tan x}{1+\sin x})^{\frac{1}{x}}=\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}[1+(\frac{1+\tan x}{1+\sin x}-1)]^{\frac{1}{x}}=e^{\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{\tan x-\sin x}{1+\sin x}\frac{1}{x}}\\&=e^{\lim_{x\rightarrow 0}\frac{1-\cos x\sin x}{x^2}\frac{1}{x}\frac{(1+\sin x)\cos x}{}}=e^{\frac{1}{2}}\end{aligned}
